Keep March 20 and March 22 relaxed with no more than two attractions each, preserving Independence National Historical Park and The Arboretum at Penn State as highlights. Omit Penn State All-Sports Museum, Millbrook Marsh Nature Center, and Tom Tudek Memorial Park. Reserve March 23 primarily for the return drive. Choose private-room accommodations, sit-down dinners March 19–22, and include Italian food during the trip; quick roadside meals are acceptable on March 23.]
